public.text: The recurrence of registries across goals is used to justify prioritising them. Recurrence demonstrates reuse, but prioritisation should also account for governance readiness, data quality, implementation capacity, dependency risk, equity, cost, and immediate country priorities.
public.suggestedRevision: State that cross-goal recurrence is one prioritisation factor and provide additional criteria for selecting the order in which shared components are established or strengthened.
